sloka: इदं निखिलमव्यग्रं राज्यं पित्र्यमकण्टकम् ।अनुशाधि स्वधर्मेण धर्मज्ञ सह बान्धवै: ॥ २.१०६.२५॥
transliteration: idaṁ nikhilamavyagraṁ rājyaṁ pitryamakaṇṭakam ।anuśādhi svadharmeṇa dharmajña saha bāndhavai: ॥ 2.106.25॥

translations.english: O one, conversant with righteousness rule unhindered this entire kingdom along with our relations inherited from our father.
